mapper.select: SELECT t.*, c.name as customer_name, s.name as supplier_name FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON t.supplier_id = s.id ORDER BY t.transaction_date DESC
SELECT t.*, c.name as customer_name, s.name as supplier_name FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON t.supplier_id = s.id WHERE t.id = #{id}

SELECT t.*, c.name as customer_name, s.name as supplier_name FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON t.supplier_id = s.id WHERE t.transaction_number = #{transactionNumber}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transactions (transaction_number, type, status, customer_id, supplier_id, subtotal, discount_amount, tax_amount, total_amount, paid_amount, due_amount, payment_method, notes, transaction_date, created_at, updated_at, created_by) VALUES (#{transactionNumber}, #{type}, #{status}, #{customerId}, #{supplierId}, #{subtotal}, #{discountAmount}, #{taxAmount}, #{totalAmount}, #{paidAmount}, #{dueAmount}, #{paymentMethod}, #{notes}, #{transactionDate}, NOW(), NOW(), #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE transactions SET status = #{status}, subtotal = #{subtotal}, discount_amount = #{discountAmount}, tax_amount = #{taxAmount}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, paid_amount = #{paidAmount}, due_amount = #{dueAmount}, payment_method = #{paymentMethod}, notes = #{notes}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transaction_items (transaction_id, fruit_id, fruit_name, unit, quantity, unit_price, total_price, discount_percent) VALUES (#{transactionId}, #{fruitId}, #{fruitName}, #{unit}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{totalPrice}, #{discountPercent})
mapper.select: SELECT ti.*, f.name as fruit_name, f.unit FROM transaction_items ti JOIN fruits f ON ti.fruit_id = f.id WHERE ti.transaction_id = #{transactionId}

SELECT CONCAT(#{type}, '-', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m'), '-', LPAD(IFNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(transaction_number, '-', -1) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) + 1, 4, '0')) FROM transactions WHERE type = #{type} AND DATE_FORMAT(transaction_date, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m')
